high_level_description: stc brand style, two women walking through a bright, modern shopping mall carrying colorful shopping bags.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A modern shopping mall interior with a curved white glass and steel ceiling in a geometric triangular pattern, polished white flooring, multiple levels with glass balustrades, and glass-fronted retail stores.

elements.desc: A woman wearing a black long-sleeved dress, walking through the mall.
A woman wearing a dark brown abaya and black hijab, walking beside her.
Pink and purple shopping bags carried by the two women.
A retail store visible in the background with its brand name displayed above the storefront.
